verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, so official developer SDKs are a category error for this kind of product, and buyers comparing law firms would not reasonably ask about them. Fenwick Labs mentions client-facing extranets, AI tools and custom 'web services', but nothing shows the firm ships SDKs. The 404 probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI only confirm that no developer surface is exposed, so the axis does not flip to applicable.
